records.coverage_note: Read in full. The proclamation of the Landfrieden and all enumerated provisions (§1 to §20) are covered as Enactment factoids with rf:partOf to the main act; the authorship note after the dash is correctly skipped. No unsupported factoid found. Remaining issues concern role choice and labels.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22752:p12-13-15-waffentragen
findings.description: Bauern, Kaufleute and Ritter are the groups the provision regulates, not participants in an act. rv:Participant is the vocabulary's fallback, but it blurs the difference between the enacting ruler and the regulated groups. The parallel procedural provision (§10), which names Bauern and Ritter in the same way, carries no references at all, so the treatment is inconsistent.
findings.evidence_quote: spricht das Verbot bzw. die Erlaubnis zum Waffentragen für Bauern, Kaufleute und Ritter [§12, 13 und 15] aus
findings.proposed_correction: Either drop the group references from both provisions or treat them consistently; record the lack of a role for the regulated party as a model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22752:p11-getreidepreis
findings.description: The count is the actor who is to fix the grain price under the provision; rv:Participant hides that the provision assigns him a task. Typing him as rf:FunctionalActor is correct.
findings.evidence_quote: regelt die Festsetzung des Getreidepreises durch den Grafen nach Mariä Geburt (September 8) [§11]
findings.proposed_correction: Keep as is or record the missing role for an actor charged by a provision as a model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22752:right-weide-wald
findings.description: The right label 'die Erlaubnis, Weide und Wald' is a truncated fragment that does not name the right; the permission is to use pasture and forest for one's own needs.
findings.evidence_quote: die Erlaubnis, Weide und Wald unter Hintanhaltung von Verwüstungen und Schäden für die eigenen Bedürfnisse zu verwenden [§20]
findings.proposed_correction: Use 'Weide und Wald' or the full clause as label; keep the condition literal as it is.

model_gaps: No role for the group a general enactment regulates (addressees of a norm as distinct from addressees of a letter).
No role for an office-holder charged with a task by a provision (the count fixing the grain price).

records.coverage_note: Read in full. The papal command with its condition, the threatened penalty with 'bei Zuwiderhandlung', and the investiture of Wichmann by the king are covered. Actor identifications (Eugen E000589, Domkapitel M000042, Wichmann W000436, König as shared ruler) match the packet. The main issue is that the investiture is stated as a narrated act although the regest gives it as reported speech of the papal letter.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22753:investitur
findings.description: The investiture stands in the subjunctive of reported speech ('investiert worden sei'): the regest reports what the pope's letter asserts, not a fact the regest itself narrates. The factoid records it as a plain Appointment without any trace of this framing. The qualifiers keep 'auch schon' but drop the 'sei' that marks the report.
findings.evidence_quote: vom König auch schon investiert worden sei
findings.proposed_correction: Add rf:qualifier "investiert worden sei" (exact wording) to keep the reported-speech marker, or link the factoid to the papal command as content of that letter, and record the lack of a claim-attribution mechanism as a model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22753:investitur
findings.description: Two statements are merged: Wichmann obtained the Magdeburg see through royal favour, and the king invested him. 'durch königliche Gunst' is stored as a qualifier, although it describes the means of acquiring the see rather than qualifying the investiture.
findings.evidence_quote: der sich durch königliche Gunst den Magdeburger Stuhl zu verschaffen wußte
findings.proposed_correction: Acceptable as one Appointment; alternatively move 'durch königliche Gunst' to rf:ground.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22753:strafandrohung
findings.description: The threat carries no references; the threatening pope and the threatened chapter are only reachable through rf:partOf.
findings.evidence_quote: droht bei Zuwiderhandlung den Verlust von Amt und Pfründe an
findings.proposed_correction: Optionally add the pope as Grantor and the chapter as Addressee.

model_gaps: No way to mark a factoid as the reported assertion of an actor within the regest (reported speech in a letter), as distinct from what the regest narrates.

records.coverage_note: Read in full. The bishops' earlier letter (Reg. 103), the papal reply with all eleven addressees and the refusal of consent to Wichmann's translation are covered. Identifications are correct: the three archbishops without matching candidates stay local, Anselm von Havelberg (A000934) and Konrad von Passau (K000327) match by name and former see. The pope's astonishment and disapproval of their intervention are not encoded.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22754:antwortschreiben
findings.description: The pope as writer of his own letter and the bishops as writers of Reg. 103 are recorded as rv:Participant. This follows from the missing sender role, not from a misreading.
findings.evidence_quote: Papst Eugen (III.) schreibt an die Erzbischöfe
findings.proposed_correction: No change within the contract; record the missing sender role as model gap.

findings.description: The pope's statement that he is astonished at the bishops' intervention and cannot approve it is part of the letter's content and is not represented. The vocabulary offers no type for a stance or disapproval, so this is a model gap rather than an extraction error.
findings.evidence_quote: daß er über ihr Eintreten in der Magdeburger Angelegenheit maßlos erstaunt sei, dieses nicht billigen könne
findings.proposed_correction: Record as model gap; do not force it into Enactment.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22754:verweigerung-zustimmung
findings.description: A declaration that consent will never be given is typed rv:Enactment and the pope is given rv:Grantor. This is the closest available type, but the passage states a refusal, not a legal determination; the 'niemals' qualifier keeps the essential wording.
findings.evidence_quote: er zur Transferierung Wichmanns auf den Magdeburger Stuhl aus den dargelegten Gründen niemals seine Zustimmung geben werde
findings.proposed_correction: Keep as is and record a refusal or denial of consent as model gap.

model_gaps: No sender or author role for a Communication.
No act type for a refusal of consent or a stated disapproval.

records.coverage_note: Read in full. The long dispute between the monastery and Count Simon, the judgment awarding the Hof Schwindrazheim to Abbot Konrad, and the ruler's documentation are covered; the witness list and chancery notes are correctly skipped. Identifications (Konrad K000350, Schwarzach monastery S000416 as community, Simon S000797) match the packet. No error found.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22755:streit
findings.description: Both parties of the dispute are rv:Participant. The passage does not say who claimed and who responded, so the fallback is justified.
findings.evidence_quote: um den das Kloster lange mit Graf Simon von Saarbrücken im Streit lag
findings.proposed_correction: None.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22755:beurkundung
findings.description: The documentation of the judgment ('beurkundet') is typed rv:Communication with the abbot as Beneficiary. This is defensible; rf:refersToAct from the Judgment to the Dispute extends the property beyond its confirmation use, which is acceptable.
findings.evidence_quote: Friedrich beurkundet, daß er Abt Konrad von Schwatzach
findings.proposed_correction: None required.

model_gaps: No act type for the documentation (Beurkundung) of an earlier act.

records.coverage_note: Read in full. The single sentence, a summons of Folkwin and Widekind von Schwalenberg for their violence against Corvey, is covered by one factoid with the reason kept literally. Identifications F000280, W000454 and Corvey C000961 as community match. 'Auf diesen Termin' points to another regest and was rightly not resolved.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22756:summons
findings.description: A summons is typed rv:Dispute because the vocabulary has no summons type; the extractor documents this. Judge and Respondent roles are a reasonable reading of 'lädt ... vor'. Corvey as injured party is rv:Participant; the passage does not make it claimant.
findings.evidence_quote: lädt Friedrich Folkwin und Widekind von Schwalenberg wegen ihrer Gewalttaten gegen das Kloster Corvey vor
findings.proposed_correction: None within the contract.

model_gaps: No act type for a summons before a court.
No role for the injured party where the passage does not state a complaint.

records.coverage_note: Read in full. Protection, the general confirmation, the four listed donations with consent clauses, and the stated marriages, parent relations and the brother relation are covered; witnesses and chancery notes are skipped. Keeping both Ulrichs local is defensible because two register candidates (U000176, U000177) fit. The fact that the gifts were made in Friedrich's presence is not kept on the donations.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22757:donation-ulrich
findings.description: Each donation cites 'dem Kloster Salem in seiner Gegenwart geschenkten Güter' as second evidence, but the qualifier 'in seiner Gegenwart' (the gifts were made in Friedrich's presence) is not recorded on any donation; the ruler's presence is the link between the earlier gifts and the protection.
findings.evidence_quote: dem Kloster Salem in seiner Gegenwart geschenkten Güter
findings.proposed_correction: Add rf:qualifier "in seiner Gegenwart" to the four donation factoids, or a reference to the ruler with a suitable role if the contract allowed one.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22757:donation-ulrich
findings.description: The church of Frankenhofen is 'übergeben', not 'geschenkt'; typing it rv:Donation relies on the umbrella phrase 'geschenkten Güter'. The consent clause is stored as rf:condition, which reads consent as a condition rather than as an accompanying circumstance.
findings.evidence_quote: die von Ulrich von Herrlingen (Hurninge) mit Zustimmung seiner Gemahlin und seines Sohnes Ulrich übergebene Kirche von Frankenhofen
findings.proposed_correction: Acceptable; optionally move the consent wording to rf:qualifier and record a consent role as model gap.

findings.description: Eticho is called the Pfalzgraf's ministerial. This dependence is a stated legal relation the vocabulary cannot express (FeudalRelationship would overreach).
findings.evidence_quote: gemeinsam mit seinem Ministerialen Eticho
findings.proposed_correction: Record as model gap.

model_gaps: No role for consenting kin in a donation.
No state type for ministeriality or personal dependence.

records.coverage_note: Read in full. The cousin relation and the sending of Richildis to Spain are covered; Richildis is correctly identified as R000585. The betrothal to King Alfons VII., the most consequential relation of the passage, is not encoded, and Alfons (candidate A000646) is not referenced at all. The extractor documents this as a model gap.

findings.description: The passage states a betrothal between Richildis and King Alfons VII. of Castile. The contract has no betrothal type, and rv:Marriage would overreach, so the omission is a model gap; but the consequence is that the central kinship-relevant statement of the regest and its second actor are lost entirely.
findings.evidence_quote: die mit König Alfons VII. von Kastilien (rege Hispanorum) verlobt ist
findings.proposed_correction: Record as model gap with high priority; once a betrothal type exists, add a StateFactoid with Richildis and Alfons (A000646) as parties and 'verlobt' as qualifier.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22758:mission-spanien
findings.description: Friedrich as sender is rv:Participant for lack of a sender role. Richildis as rv:Envoy fits the definition 'wer entsandt wird' literally, though she is sent as bride, not to carry a message. 'mit großem Gefolge' is not kept.
findings.evidence_quote: Friedrich entsendet seine Cousine (Richildis)
findings.proposed_correction: Optionally add rf:qualifier "mit großem Gefolge"; record the sender role as model gap.

model_gaps: No type for betrothal (Verlobung) as a state or act distinct from marriage.
No sender role for a Mission.

records.coverage_note: Read in full. Covered: the mandate to Wibald to promote Adelgoz's case with the king, the Ulm decision of the laymen, and the pope's expression of dismay. Not covered: the pope's report of the conspiracy in Rome at Arnold of Brescia's instigation, and the second mandate that Wibald inform King Friedrich confidentially so that he can make arrangements. That is roughly half of the regest.

findings.description: The second mandate (Wibald is to inform the king confidentially about the conspiracy) is omitted although it is of exactly the same kind as the extracted first mandate and the contract can express it as rv:Appointment or rv:Request with Eugen as Grantor, Wibald as Recipient and Friedrich as Addressee. The preceding report to Wibald about the planned new regime and imperial election in Rome, instigated by Arnold of Brescia (candidate A001236), could be a rv:Communication; the planned acts themselves stay unasserted ('geplant sei').
findings.evidence_quote: worüber Wibald König Friedrich vertraulich unterrichten solle, damit dieser die nötigen Anordnungen treffen könne
findings.proposed_correction: Add an Appointment or Request factoid for the instruction to inform the king, with rf:qualifier "vertraulich" and rf:ground "damit dieser die nötigen Anordnungen treffen könne"; add a Communication factoid for the report of the conspiracy with Arnold referenced, without asserting the planned election.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22759:mandate-adelgoz
findings.description: King Friedrich is recorded as rv:Addressee of the mandate, although the mandate is addressed to Wibald and the king is only the person before whom the matter is to be promoted. The extractor's comment acknowledges this; no participation is asserted.
findings.evidence_quote: die Angelegenheit des Bischofs Adelgoz von Chur bei König Friedrich zu fördern
findings.proposed_correction: Acceptable; record a role for the target of an intercession as model gap.

model_gaps: No role for the target of an intercession.
No sender role for a Communication.
No way to record a planned but unperformed act (conspiracy, planned election) other than omitting it.

records.coverage_note: Read in full. Protection, the confirmation 'wie seine Vorgänger', the specific confirmations of Paludano and Gonzaga (for the salvation of Konrad III.) and of Pegognaga after Lothar's precedent, and the Oheim relation are covered; witnesses and chancery notes are skipped. Identifications (Polirone P000906, Konrad III. K000316, Lothar III. L000682) match. Minor issues only.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22760:kinship-konrad
findings.description: Friedrich's reference carries rf:nameInSource "Friedrich", but the passage that states the kinship names him only through the possessive 'seines'. The guidelines require the wording naming the actor in this passage.
findings.evidence_quote: seines Oheims, Konrad (III.)
findings.proposed_correction: Set rf:nameInSource "seines" for Friedrich in the kinship factoid, or add the passage naming Friedrich as a second selector.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22760:lothar-precedent
findings.description: Lothar's earlier act is typed rv:Confirmation. 'nach dem Vorgang Lothars' says only that Lothar acted before; whether he granted or confirmed is not stated. The reading is plausible but not secured by the passage.
findings.evidence_quote: nach dem Vorgang Lothars (III.) Pegognaga (Pigugnaga)
findings.proposed_correction: Acceptable; optionally note the uncertain type in a comment.

records.coverage_note: Read in full. Only the congratulation letter and Friedrich's election are covered. Not covered: Wezel's regret that Friedrich did not obtain confirmation by the city of Rome, his stance against clerical claims to rule, his denunciation of the Donation of Constantine, and his advice to send Counts Rudolf of Ramsberg and Ulrich of Lenzburg and Eberhard of Bodman to Rome and to guard against innovations there. The advice is the operative content of the letter and names three actors with packet candidates.

findings.description: The advice to send named counts and jurists to Rome is omitted, although the contract can express it as rv:Request with Wezel, Friedrich as Addressee and the proposed envoys referenced (Rudolf R001192, Ulrich U000179, Eberhard E000052), without asserting that a mission took place. As extracted, three named actors of the regest disappear.
findings.evidence_quote: rät ihm, die Grafen Rudolf von Ramsberg und Ulrich von Lenzburg sowie andere geeignete und rechtserfahrene Männer, wie Eberhard von Bodman, nach Rom zu entsenden
findings.proposed_correction: Add a rv:Request factoid (partOf the letter) with Wezel as Petitioner or Participant, Friedrich as Addressee and the three named men with rv:Envoy or rv:Participant, plus the second advice on precautions in Rome as a further partOf factoid.

findings.description: The regret that Friedrich did not obtain confirmation by Rome states a confirmation that did not happen, and the denunciation of the Donation of Constantine is a judgement about a document. Neither negation nor stance can be expressed in the contract.
findings.evidence_quote: bedauert, daß er nicht die Bestätigung durch die Stadt Rom eingeholt habe
findings.proposed_correction: Record as model gap.

findings.subject: urn:regesta:22761:election
findings.description: The election is supported only as the object of the congratulation; the electors are unnamed. Typing it rv:Appointment with Friedrich as Recipient is acceptable and asserts no date.
findings.evidence_quote: gratuliert Friedrich zu seiner Wahl
findings.proposed_correction: None.

model_gaps: No representation of a negated act (a confirmation not obtained).
No act type for advice or a stated judgement about a document (Konstantinische Schenkung als Lügenwerk).
No sender role for a Communication.
